mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace (workspace_code, workspace_name, workspace_type, status, owner_user_id, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workspaceCode}, #{workspaceName}, #{workspaceType}, #{status}, #{ownerUserId}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_code, workspace_name, workspace_type, status, owner_user_id, description, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace WHERE workspace_code = #{workspaceCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, workspace_code, workspace_name, workspace_type, status, owner_user_id, description, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND workspace_type = #{workspaceType} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, workspace_code, workspace_name, workspace_type, status, owner_user_id, description, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
